indicators.name: Share of production inputs outside the training distribution; feature-distribution alerts
indicators.meaning: The population or data feed has moved, so validation figures no longer apply

indicators.name: Accuracy on recent labelled cases, where outcomes arrive
indicators.meaning: Concept drift: what the model learned no longer holds

indicators.name: Override rate; agreement with the model on a blind sample
indicators.meaning: A rise: the model is worse or trust is falling. A fall towards zero: review may be rubber-stamping

indicators.name: Complaints and explanation requests per thousand decisions; appeals overturned
indicators.meaning: Harm reaching people outside the organisation, often before any internal measure moves

indicators.name: Incidents and near-misses, with time from awareness to report
indicators.meaning: Control failure; a serious-incident clock may be running

indicators.name: Vendor version changes; regression pass rate per version
indicators.meaning: A changed model behind a stable interface

indicators.name: Cost per transaction against plan
indicators.meaning: Abuse, retries, longer outputs or a price change

indicators.name: Tools found against tools inventoried; pilots past end date
indicators.meaning: Shadow AI growing; pilots going live
